howto.what: 装上后，当你询问关于golden_man_single工具的命令用法时，Claude会查询内置的curl手册，解释选项、语法和示例，比如告诉你`-s`是静默模式，并展示`curl https://example.com`这样的例子。
howto.when: 当你想了解golden_man_single命令行工具的用法，或需要查询curl命令的选项、示例等时触发。

say.text: golden_man_single 的 curl 命令有哪些选项？
say.note: Claude 会查阅内置手册，列出选项。

say.text: curl 的 -s 参数是什么意思？
say.note: Claude 会解释该参数的作用。

say.text: 给我一个使用 curl 获取网页的示例。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask about command usage of the golden_man_single tool, Claude will consult the built-in curl man page to explain options, syntax, and examples, e.g., telling you `-s` means silent mode and showing `curl https://example.com`.
howto.when_en: When you need to understand the golden_man_single command-line tool's usage, or look up curl command options and examples.

say_en.text: What options does the curl command in golden_man_single have?
say_en.note: Claude will look up the built-in man page and list options.

say_en.text: What does the -s parameter of curl mean?
Give me an example of using curl to fetch a web page.
say_en.note: Claude will show a sample command.
